prompt: Create a mystical fantasy logo for "MegaDice" in the same art style and aesthetic as the MegaBook reference image provided. **Visual Concept:** A magical floating glass container with ornate golden Art Deco frames and geometric circuitry patterns. Inside the transparent glass chamber, viscous prismatic liquid swirls with rainbow iridescence. Suspended within the goo are several polyhedral dice (D20, D12, D6) that pulse and breathe—growing larger then shrinking in a rhythmic cycle. Each die is composed of millions of microscopic crystalline dice that refract light, creating the prismatic chromatic effect throughout the liquid. **Key Elements:** - Golden ornate frame with the same geometric circuit patterns from MegaBook - Glass container showing viscous prismatic goo inside - Multiple dice shapes (D20 prominent, with D12 and D6) floating in the liquid - Dice made of millions of tiny microscopic dice (visible as glittering facets) - Rainbow light refraction and prismatic caustics - Magical particles and sparkles emanating from the container - Dark cosmic background with golden and purple magical energy **Style Requirements:** - Match the MegaBook aesthetic: fantasy meets art deco technology - Same color palette: deep golds, royal purples, mystical blues, warm magical glows - Golden geometric circuit patterns framing the composition - Dramatic rim lighting and magical particle effects - Rich, saturated colors with strong contrast **Text Element:** At the bottom, display "MegaDice" in the same ornate golden serif font style as "MegaBook", with decorative flourishes. **Technical:** High detail, fantasy illustration style, magical realism, volumetric lighting, particle effects, 8k quality
